lines.en: I don't come to school much anymore. I'm too vulnerable when I'm here and, more often than not, all it does is evoke bad memories. But I made an exception today.
lines.zh: 我不怎么来学校了。我在这儿太脆弱，而且大多数时候，来这儿只会勾起糟糕的回忆。但今天我破了个例。

lines.en: After calling Wakana and finding out that she's alone in her office, I swallowed my pride and decided to join her there and keep her company while she grades papers.
lines.zh: 给 Wakana 打了电话、发现她一个人在办公室之后，我吞下自尊，决定过去陪她改卷子。

lines.en: She doesn't demand that I help her this time, as she'd always done in the past. Instead, she makes small talk with me and tells me to help myself to one of the many poetry collections on her shelves.
lines.zh: 这次她没像以前那样要求我帮忙。相反，她跟我闲聊，还让我随便从她书架上那一堆诗集里拿一本看。

lines.en: I try not to read anymore unless I absolutely have to as that, too, evokes bad memories.
lines.zh: 除非万不得已，我尽量不再读书了——因为那也会勾起糟糕的回忆。

lines.en: But when the vast majority of my memories are {i}bad{/i} to begin with, I have to learn to accept that, sometimes, wading through them is inevitable.
lines.zh: 但既然我绝大部分记忆本来就都是{i}坏{/i}的，我就得学会接受：有时候，涉过它们是躲不掉的。

lines.en: As such, I grab a book off of her shelf and begin to flip through it.
lines.zh: 于是我从她书架上抽了一本，开始翻。

lines.en: I picked up the wrong book.
